label: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA — NOT REAL PATIENT DATA
transcript: Doctor: Batao kya problem hai? Patient: Mujhe do din se loose motion ho raha hai aur thoda vomiting bhi hua ek baar. Doctor: Dehydration se bachne ke liye ORS lijiye, ek sachet subah shaam do baar, teen din tak. Aur Metronidazole 400 mg teen baar roz, paanch din. Bahar ka khana avoid kijiye.
